title: espeletia neriifolia
intro: Espeletia neriifolia, commonly known as "the queen of the Andes," is a plant species native to the high-altitude regions of South America. This plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its various health benefits. The health benefits of Espeletia neriifolia include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, among others.
